meta.evidence_status: PROPOSED DESIGN (study W's whole-pen collar, the review's option B with the V2 load path: the reference design for shifting the whole pen, a bench experiment, not adopted for the product (proposed DEC-051); CALC masses from volumes and catalogue parts; ASSUMPTION dimensions; nothing built or measured)
meta.concept: the hand holds a collar that rests on the paper; the whole inner pen swings in it on a 2-axis pivot, driven by two motors that push back on the collar and hand; a small fine nib (study B) trims the rest
meta.replaces_note: a new architecture, not a Rev J add-on: the 24 mm shell becomes a 100 mm long, 21.7 mm collar around a 92 mm, 12 mm swinging pen; Rev J's own nose can sit in the inner pen instead of the fine nib only if the inner pen grows to 24 mm (then the collar is about 33 mm across); two geared 0824 motors (8 mm across) do not fit beside the swinging pen, so the actuator is a coil plate in the collar's rear wall

axis: z along the pen axis from the ball tip (z = 0) toward the back; x in the tilt plane, positive away from the paper; y transverse

components.label: Collar (what the hand holds)
components.function: The fingers hold it and the thumb-index web rests on it. It does not swing: the pen inside it does.
components.part: custom (PA12-CF, 1.2 mm wall, or aluminium 0.8 mm)

components.label: Skid ring on the collar
components.function: Rests on the paper and carries the writing force, so the swinging pen only carries its small refill spring.

components.label: Two-axis flexure pivot
components.function: Holds the inner pen 50 mm behind the tip and lets it tilt ±4.6° each way: ±4 mm at the tip.
components.part: custom cross-strip flexure (titanium or spring steel)

components.label: Two-axis coil plate (collar's rear wall)
components.function: Pushes on the magnets of the inner pen's end face, 42 mm behind the pivot, to swing the pen; the push-back goes into the collar and the hand (the Liftware principle). A long lever: the static load costs about 0.05 W.
components.part: custom flat coils on a steel back plate (Rev J C1S actuator principle)

components.label: Collar end wall
components.function: Closes the collar; charging contacts and the switch.

components.label: Skid load cell
components.function: Measures the writing force: it tells the pen it is on the paper (the refill may then follow the paper) and the actuator how much to hold.

components.label: Inner pen (swings)
components.function: Everything that writes: refill, small fine nib, cell and board. The collar's actuator swings all of it; balanced about the pivot.

components.label: Small fine nib (±1 mm)
components.function: Study B's balanced nib: it trims the last millimetre quickly; the collar takes the large swings.

components.label: Board and IMU
components.function: Estimates the tremor and drives the actuator and the nib.

components.label: Li-ion cell 10280
components.function: Power; behind the pivot, balancing the nib in front.

components.label: Actuator magnets (inner pen's end face)
components.function: Four magnet poles facing the coil plate; they slide over it as the pen tilts.

components.label: Optional gyro tail (bench experiment only)
components.function: Two 27 g tungsten rotors at 25000 rpm storing 18 J: an experiment for the review's gate G5, not part of any pen.
